rationale: The replication successfully reproduces all four mechanism-level physics claims: orbital dominates spin (ratio ~6000x vs paper's ~150x, same qualitative regime), SOC is required (dipole vanishes without SOC), non-perturbative weak-SOC enhancement (negative slope in log-log scaling), and T-oddness (sign flips with Néel reversal). However, the absolute magnitude in physical units (χ = -1.3 (ℏ/e)Ω⁻¹V⁻¹) is not reproduced due to using a surrogate tight-binding model instead of DFT+Wannier for real CuMnAs. The quantitative orbital/spin ratio overshoots by ~40x, and detailed figures (μ-scan, k-resolved maps, angular dependence) are not attempted. This constitutes honest partial replication of the core physics without material-specific quantitative agreement.
